name: adventureorno

scripts.verify:live: set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && npm run verify:live --workspace app

//rolldown: Vite 8 build the app with ROLLDOWN, not rollup, and rolldown declares every platform binding as a normal optional dependency - all 15 are in package-lock.json, linux-x64-gnu included. So npm ci on Linux CI installs the right native without help. The old workaround here pinned @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu because the photo-gateway worker still ran vitest 2, which loaded rollup; #161 moved that worker to vitest 4 and rollup left the tree entirely, leaving the pin referring to a package nothing depends on. Removed 2026-08-29. If a Linux-only native ever goes missing again, check whether the bundler changed before re-adding a pin.
